about: Storyboard for tools/film/render-narrated.js --storyboard: one shot per picture change. The first shot of a scene opens it; every later shot cuts 0.12 s before its spoken_anchor, which must occur exactly once in that scene's spoken_text_exact. An art_path is an absolute path or a file name found in --art-dir (default assets/paintings, which holds the three paintings named here); --art-map <file>, a JSON file of {"<shot>": "<image path>"} keyed by shot number, points a shot at another file, such as a plate built elsewhere. Give every picture its own file name: the renderer frames stills by file name. A plate that builds up gets one shot per step, on the phrase that brings its items in: 03-checklist-2.png and 03-checklist-4.png are two steps of the checklist plate that tools/plates/plates.example.json builds, whose labels stand in for the words a narration speaks. These shots belong to kit/templates/script/manifest.example.json.
